concentration_theorem.proof_boundary: the bound uses P_m(d)<=4^d, every proper divisor d<=m/2, and fewer than m proper divisors; it is deliberately coarse

necklace_conjugacy_theorem.complexity_boundary: the conjugate necklace system is reversible and exactly solvable; it is not claimed to be chaotic or interacting
necklace_conjugacy_theorem.intertwining: Phi conjugates one full Margolus tick to one cyclic rotation of an m-letter word over the four-letter alphabet {0,1}^2

nonclaims: chaos or interaction in a system conjugate to a four-letter rotation
a target divisor, functional equation, or counting-law match
arithmetic local factors, Euler factors, root numbers, or automorphy
a uniform self-adjoint Hilbert--Polya realization across the family
Route-B authorization or a solution of the larger program

period_theorem.exact_points: P_m(d)=sum_(e|d) mu(d/e)4^e for d|m and P_m(d)=0 otherwise
period_theorem.support: every exact configuration period divides m

pivot_record.reason: the general Rule-90 trace-zero count has no uniform elementary reduction and three preceding rounds already occupy that lineage
pivot_record.rejected_candidate: a fourth consecutive broad composite-clock Rule-90 closed-law paper
pivot_record.replacement: a reversible two-phase Margolus block cellular automaton with an exact four-letter necklace conjugacy

progress_and_boundary.progress: pivots from an overused Rule-90 lineage to a two-phase partitioned cellular automaton and proves a full all-size conjugacy, period law, concentration estimate, reversor, and Koopman determinant
progress_and_boundary.route_a_obstruction: the exact finite source determinant has no target divisor or global target-analytic comparison and the finite Koopman lift is not a Hilbert--Polya construction

reversibility_and_koopman.antiunitary: Theta f(x)=conjugate(f(Rx)) is involutive and Theta*U_T*Theta=U_T^(-1)
reversibility_and_koopman.koopman_space: l2 of the finite configuration set with counting measure
reversibility_and_koopman.operator_boundary: the finite same-clock Koopman lift is self-adjoint exactly for m<=2 and non-self-adjoint for m>=3; no uniform self-adjoint Hilbert--Polya realization is claimed

site_permutation_theorem.cell_motion: tau(i)=i+2 mod 2m for even i and tau(i)=i-2 mod 2m for odd i
site_permutation_theorem.order: tau^m=identity, including the m=1 identity boundary

source_lock.allowed_data: the frozen two-layer local swap schedule and source-derived finite clocks only
source_lock.clock: one full tick is T=B after A; neither A nor B alone is a full source clock
source_lock.cutoff: all formulas hold for every m>=1; finite ledgers use m<=16 and direct state enumeration uses m<=8
source_lock.determinant_convention: finite Artin--Mazur zeta and the same-clock Koopman determinant det(I-zU_T)
source_lock.family: every integer m>=1; finite exact replay uses 1<=m<=16
source_lock.forbidden_data: target zero or prime tables, arithmetic local factors, Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, Hilbert--Polya operators, and Route-B inputs
source_lock.normalization: uniform labeled binary configurations, exact least full-tick periods, then geometric cycles
source_lock.object: binary configurations on a ring of 2m sites with two staggered Margolus swap layers A and B
source_lock.precision: exact permutations, integers, rational probabilities, and symbolic polynomials
